_note: feed slug -> Pinterest board. Each feed URL https://characternamehub.com/pin-feeds/<slug>.xml must be connected to its board once in Pinterest Settings > Auto-publish.

elf-names.use_for: elves of any kind not covered by a more specific elf board (night, snow, astral, sea, female/male elf...)

fantasy-character-names.use_for: fantasy races, classes and characters (dwarf, orc, witch, paladin, vampire, angel, demon, jedi...)

fantasy-creature-names.use_for: monsters, beasts, mythical creatures, pets/familiars (kaiju, griffin, hellhound...)

fantasy-place-names.use_for: kingdoms, cities, towns, taverns, guilds, clans, ships, planets, worlds

game-anime-names.use_for: video game, anime, username/gamertag and pop-culture generators, titles and other ideas
